frames.description: Sim-racing cockpit view: a hand holds a black 3D-printed round controller wheel rim in the foreground; the monitor shows a Renault Clio ahead on track, a digital dash reading gear N with 'RENAULT SPORT', and a blue RACELOGIC timing box on the right.
Same cockpit: the hand holds the 3D-printed wheel rim while the screen shows several cars ahead on a straight; dash still in N, RACELOGIC box visible.
Cockpit with the printed wheel in hand; the screen shows the track with a car ahead and grandstands along the right.
Screen shows a green car marked '06' and other cars close ahead on track; dash reads gear 2; the printed wheel is held in view.
Racing on track with a green car to the left and other cars ahead; RACELOGIC timer reads 0:14.823 and the dash shows gear 2.
A corner section with tents and grandstands in the background and cars ahead; RACELOGIC timer reads 0:18.810, dash gear 3.
A long straight/curve lined with trees, cars ahead; RACELOGIC timer reads 0:22.812, dash gear 2.
Close-up of the hand gripping the 3D-printed round wheel rim in front of the monitor; RACELOGIC timer reads 0:26.817 and the dash shows gear 1, 'RENAULT SPORT'.
